marketInfo.assetDescription: Yield-bearing token with a dynamically managed strategy curated by Hyperithm on Midas. Active allocation of collateral across defi-protocols to capture the highest yield and other incentive opportunity.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
Potential risks and events which may lead to the yield going negative:

  • Underlying Strategy Risk: The reference portfolio comprises market-neutral, stablecoin-focused DeFi strategies. Unexpected market events, protocol failures, liquidity shortfalls, or mispricing could lead to reduced returns or losses in the underlying strategies.
  • Protocol Risk: Smart contract vulnerabilities, oracle failures, or integration issues with DeFi protocols used in the reference strategies could negatively affect performance.
  • Counterparty Risk: The appointed risk manager, Hyperithm, and any underlying protocol counterparties could fail to deliver expected execution or risk controls.
  • Regulatory/Legal Risk: Changes in applicable laws or enforcement actions could restrict certain strategies or limit product operations.
  • Operational Risk: Failures in execution, custody, or settlement infrastructure could cause delays or losses.

From underlying protocol
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
• Minor rewards from points will be directly reflected in price updates
  • Major rewards are converted into USDC and distributed through Merkl
  • Points earned from this pool changes dynamically due to the nature of the underlying asset, refer here for the most updated list of points.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
gmETH (WETH-WETH) represents the single token liquidity for ETH/USD (WETH-WETH) market on GMX. This pool enables users to provide liquidity without being exposed to typical LP IL from rebalancing while earning fees such as trading fees, liquidation fees and borrowing fees.

1 GM Liquidity Unit represents GM token excluding the fees component for GM. Where the yield being tokenised on this pool represents the fees generated for 1 GM in ETH/USD (WETH-WETH).

1 YT represents the fees generated for 1 GM in ETH/USD (WETH-WETH) market such as trading fees, liquidation fees and borrowing fees.

1 PT is redeemable for 1 GM Liquidity Unit during maturity, which GM price fluctuates according to WETH price and trader's PnL.

marketInfo.assetDescription: USD.AI is a synthetic dollar protocol designed to finance the physical infrastructure of AI (Compute) and other emerging sectors. USDai is a fully-backed synthetic dollar, which allows it to be redeemed instantly at all times. It does not earn any yield from loans originated by the protocol but earns additional points which entitles users to more allocation during the ICO of USD.AI.
marketInfo.riskInvolved: This pool has minimal risk of generating negative yield
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
• Points earned for this protocol entitles you to allocation to purchase USD.AI tokens during TGE, rather than airdrops. Refer here for more details.
  • KYC is required to purchase USD.AI tokens during TGE.
  • USD.AI points has been updated to 10x since 19 Nov 2025
